findings.detail: Frozen source permits repeated source branches in sections while resolve_v3 rejects them. Independent failure evidence identifies INVALID_SOURCE_SECTION after six visible confirmed reads and failed write. This supports repairing the demonstrated contract gap, not identifying a specific duplicate: submitted arguments are absent and duplicate-versus-unknown is not definitively resolved.

Canonical source-ID ordered tuples enumerate all eligible 3/4/5 source subsets, bounded at 16 for five sources. Shared source definitions retain existing fields, evidence bindings and operation constraints without multiplying card schemas. Prompt addition is a generic contract only. No model-output merging or rewriting is proposed.

The frozen generation and replay construct enclosing anyOf envelopes independently; local JSONPointers must resolve against that outer root. The proposed pure helper hoists fixed local definitions to the envelope root and is reused by both reconstruction paths, while a standalone report schema remains valid for phase instructions. Existing full-schema equality, exact phase comparison, options and budget checks remain necessary. Tampered definitions, references, tuples and phase must be rejected before dispatch or during replay.

Plan preserves resolve_v3, render_v3, _fact_evidence, source/card provenance, distinct URL/body checks, empty-page exclusion, scanners, file transaction, diagnostics and END/ACK protocol. Schema restrictions do not establish semantic quality or original-question coverage. Refusal remains available when evidence is insufficient.

Read-only inspection of pinned Python reference shows local reference resolution, allow_fetch gating and tuple-items generation. This supports the proposed offline conversion check; it does not establish native installed-binary execution. Only fixed local references are planned, with allow_fetch=false and no fetching by the helper.

Shared definitions mitigate repeated card expansion but full requests contain schema plus phase text, so actual byte gates remain unresolved until fresh preparation. Plan explicitly preserves 32768/49152 gates, 48-card bound, long-operation and lookaround negatives, ordinary 3/4/5-source and diagnostic-shape checks. It forbids truncating schema or raising caps to pass. All time, read, model, output, POST and retry budgets remain unchanged.

This is a bounded Task3/4 supplement under the explicit diagnostics-then-evidence-based-repair sequence. No new user confirmation is required for scoped implementation. The old diagnostic allowance is consumed and evidence frozen. This review grants no run allowance: the single successor case remains conditional on new independent preparation PASS, unchanged inputs and the existing release sequence. Failed successor must not retry. E01/E03 credit cannot transfer.
